stops.name: Lima Cathedral, the true bones restored to the crypt
stops.campa: Forensic study at the University of Missouri, matching the skull's fractures against the throat-and-skull wounds the sixteenth-century chroniclers recorded of his death, confirms in 1984 what the lead inscription already claimed: these are the true bones of Francisco Pizarro. On the twenty-sixth of January 1985, four hundred and forty-four years after the Almagristas' swords found him, the real marqués is installed at last in a proper crypt of the cathedral he began, while the glass coffin that held a stranger for nearly a century is quietly emptied of its long, mistaken vigil.
